description: This file implements the core logic of an object tracking system within TensorFlow's Android tools. It defines the ObjectTracker class, managing detection, tracking, correspondence finding, and rendering of objects in video frames. The code handles frame management, keypoint detection, object registration and forgetting, and visualization, heavily relying on OpenGL for rendering.

classes.name: ObjectTracker
classes.description: Main class implementing object detection and tracking logic, managing frames, objects, keypoints, and visualization.

methods.description: Initializes a new object with appearance data from a frame and bounding box.

methods.description: Sets the previous position of a tracked object based on a past timestamp, adjusting tracking accordingly.

methods.description: Updates the current position of a tracked object.

methods.name: ObjectTracker::ForgetTarget
